text: {"sql": "SELECT agv_id, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS fault_date, fault_code, COUNT(*) AS fault_event_count FROM sf_fleet.agv_telemetry WHERE fault_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agv_id, CAST(ts AS DATE), fault_code ORDER BY fault_event_count DESC", "columns": ["agv_id", "fault_date", "fault_code", "fault_event_count"], "purpose": "Count AGV telemetry fault events by AGV, date, and fault code, ordered by highest frequency to pinpoint when faults occurred."}

data.sql: SELECT agv_id, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS fault_date, fault_code, COUNT(*) AS fault_event_count FROM sf_fleet.agv_telemetry WHERE fault_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agv_id, CAST(ts AS DATE), fault_code ORDER BY fault_event_count DESC
data.purpose: Count AGV telemetry fault events by AGV, date, and fault code, ordered by highest frequency to pinpoint when faults occurred.
